Market today: Tech is getting hammered again, driven by inflation fears (wholesale prices up big) and a deepening AI sell-off. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially leveraged names, is feeling it.

Your holdings: SMCI (-22.32%), MUU (-29.01%), SOXL (-54.06%), SPAL (-35.39%) are all SELL signals and deep in the red. SMH (TRIM, -13.08%) also needs attention. These leveraged ETFs and chip names are bleeding.

Watch: The continued fallout in AI chip names and the broader market's reaction to inflation data.

Bottom line: Focus on damage control and managing your deeply underwater leveraged positions.
plays: Trim SOXL and SPAL further if they show weakness; these leveraged ETFs are brutal on margin.
Consider trimming SMCI and MUU if they don't show immediate signs of life.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
